notes: the anointing oil: no article morpheme stands in the chain, so the supplied the goes to the construct noun שֶׁמֶן under rule 29's supply clause; the alternative putting it with the attributive מִשְׁחַת is named in the unit's note.
עֲלֵיכֶם is a prepositional predicate and takes the supplied copula on the preposition under rule 49.
according to renders כְּ as a compound preposition, headed on the content word under rule 24.
